download_corpus_cli: run the CLI to download a Wikipedia corpus by passing --corpus and --output_directory flags
download_corpus_main: call main with an output directory and corpus name to download corpus files from S3
list_available_corpora: inspect AVAILABLE_CORPORA to see which Wikipedia dumps and their files are available for download
generate_help_string: call _helpstr to generate a formatted help string listing all available corpora and descriptions
download_corpus_files: use main to download text-list-100-sec.jsonl and infobox.jsonl for a given Wikipedia corpus
